title: A Branchless UTF-8 Decoder
key_contribution: Demonstrated fully branchless multi-byte stream decoding with error detection, establishing the pattern of bitmask arithmetic for conditional computation.

title: Base64 decoding with SIMD instructions
key_contribution: The PSHUFB-bitmask lookup variant is already branchless for the main loop; this work establishes the foundation for fully branchless Base64 SIMD decode.

title: Branch Free blog
key_contribution: Blog by one of the architects of simdjson exploring branchless programming patterns for high-throughput data processing.

title: Ridiculously fast unicode (UTF-8) validation
key_contribution: Demonstrated branchless SIMD UTF-8 validation at sub-cycle-per-byte rates, proving that complex validation logic can be fully predicated.
